deviations: The online-appendix list of controls is not available; controls were reconstructed: sociodemographics = sex, age bracket, education (4), town size (5), socio-professional category, region, household size, number aged 14+, number of adults; incomes = continuous piecewise-linear income percentiles of respondent and second adult (kinks at p20, p70; second-adult terms zeroed for singles) plus single dummy; estimated gains = simule_gain and its square; other motives = belief in environmental effectiveness (Tables 4 and 6) or initial win/lose category (Table 8). Progressivity beliefs were not used (asked only to the second half of the sample, collinear with the effectiveness-information instrument).
All regressions weighted by the survey weight; heteroskedasticity-robust SEs (coefficients only are scored).
Table 6 subsample [p10;p60]: respondent's own percentile in [10,60] or (non-single) second adult's percentile in [10,60]; N = 1961 vs 1969 in the paper.
Info on environmental effectiveness (Z_E) taken as apres_modifs (second-half sample that saw the effectiveness information); Z_CC = info_CC.
Table 4 R2 is lower than the paper's (0.267 vs 0.301 in col 1), suggesting the paper's control set is larger.
notes: Data: s from after_preparation.RData (3,002 respondents). memisc-labelled columns stripped of attributes because memisc is not installed (attempts 2 and 4 crashed on this). Table 4: LPM of post-feedback belief (not lose / win) on predicted-winner indicator (simule_gagnant), initial acceptance, quadratic in estimated net gain, controls; |gain|<50 subsample gives N=757 exactly. Col 3 adds interactions with initial acceptance, Yellow Vests supporter (gilets_jaunes >= 1, i.e. part of or supports) and initial not-lose belief, plus initial win/lose category factor. Table 6 col 1: 2SLS of targeted-dividend acceptance on believing not losing, instrumented by T1, T2, T1xT2, with threshold FE, initial acceptance, income piecewise, single. Table 8 col 1: 2SLS of initial approval on believing effective ('Yes'), instrumented by Z_E and Z_CC, all 3,002. After the first estimation run I ran check_attempt once: all claims within tolerance, so the script was not changed and that run is the final one (no claim attempt). No author scripts were opened; functions stored inside the RData were not inspected.
